owasp_risk: A08 Software or Data Integrity Failures
owasp_api_cross_reference: API8:2023 Security Misconfiguration / software and data integrity failures (unsigned artifacts, insecure deserialization)
summary: Store theme upload accepts unsigned artifacts without HMAC verification, and purchase receipts are serialized/deserialized with pickle on untrusted data.

evidence.description: Detection suite asserting secure theme HMAC verification and JSON-only receipt handling; fails on vulnerable red-phase code.
